purpose: Tempo-SYNCED listening pack for judging arrangement, transitions and rhythmic stability.
listenerAssessment: NOT PERFORMED — produced for human listening.
inputs: Vocals: MTG turkish-makam-solo-voice dataset (CC BY 4.0). Beds: AERIS MUSIC CC0 instrumentals.
honesty: Tempo (and, for two cases, key) evidence is DECLARED per case rather than measured, because rubato a-cappella singing never clears the 0.5 confidence gate. Stretching, beat grids, entry placement, arrangement and the mix are all still produced by the production code path.

entries.label: 11-synced-close

entries.balanceNote: Measured BS.1770 difference is 7.18 dB; applied 6.00 dB and clamped to ±6 dB. A clamped correction means this pair needs a bigger change than a mix balance should make — the pairing or the phrase selection is the open question, not the gain.
rationale: master tempo = the instrumental's verified 112 BPM.
vocals are time-stretched ×0.893 (100 → 112 BPM, pitch preserved by WSOLA).

second vocal placement grounded in the donor's own persisted section “outro” — an encore of its closing passage, not a recurrence or semantic detection
warnings: Tempo octave is ambiguous (100 vs 112 BPM both fit); using the pairing that needs the least stretch (×0.893).
Key analysis confidence is below the trusted threshold (0.5) — automatic pitch move withheld (0 semitones).
